tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sangs rgyas sman bla'i bsnyen yig nyung ngu don tshang bzhugs so// na mo bhai ṣa dzye gu ru baiḍūrya ya/ de la 'dir sangs rgyas sman bla la bsnyen yig sngar ma mthong bas/ bya rgyud rigs 'gre mi 'khrugs par bsnyen yig sbyin sreg bcas 'byung bas 'di yang rgyas bkab ste/ bya rgyud rigs gang yang rung ba'am/ yang na rigs gsum spyi dbang ngam/ yang na sman bla bya rgyud lugs kyi dbang yang yod 'dra bas de sogs thob cing sman bla'i rjes gnang mtho brtsegs ma 'di rdo rje 'chang gis dpyad gzhir mdzad kyang ris med mkhas grub du mas gsan cing brgyud pa 'dren par mdzad pas khungs ma yin pa'i lugs su bzhag nas/ 'di nyid thob pa'i gang zag so thar ris bdun gang rung dang / byang sdom thob pa zhig gis/ sa phyogs dben gtsang gdug pa can 'grim 'grul nyung zhing / chos ldan rgyal pos skyong ba bla ma gong mas byin gyis brlabs shing / mthun rkyen dkar sdor sogs 'tshol sla ba zhig tu/ 'di'i sku bris 'bur gang rung yod na rang la zhal phyogs par bzhugs pa'am med kyang rang gi mdun phyogs der stegs ras gtsang gis bkab steng nas 'bras sogs 'bru gtsang bkram ste/ tsam pa/ dkar gsum/ mngar gsum/ bum rdzas nyer lnga rnams lhan cig chu gtsang gis sbrus pa'i zlum gtor mar dkar gyi sgor rgyan rtse dang dkyil ldir la rgyab cing pad 'dab bzhis bskor ba dngul sogs rin po che'i snod dam/ rdza sder ram/ rdo gtsang steng du bshams drung mdun bskyed kyi g.yon nas 'og bzung ba'i chu gnyis/ me tog a ka ru sogs bdug spos gla rtsi dang chang ma 'dres pa/ mar me/ dri chab zhal zas rnams sbreng tshar/ de'i phyir gnod sbyin bcu gnyis dang gzhi bdag gtor zlum yang gong bzhin mchod gtor de rnams gso chas bcas/ mal 'og tu pad dkar gyis rdo rje rgya gram mam/ g.yung drung ris rdo leb la bris te 'bras sogs 'bru phran bu bkram pa dang /

rdo shing sogs kyi sgrom stegs stan nang tshangs can skyi chags ma yin pa bting / ting shags 'thor nas rnams bsham la/ cho 'phrul sogs kyi yar ngo'i brgyad dam/ bco lnga'am mar ngo'i gnam stong lta bu'i dgong char sgrub khang du cha gsum btang / bgegs gtor bskyur zin pa dang sgo phyir gzhan srung ba'i tho dkar btsugs/ rang nyid khrus dang rdo dkar la gnas pas mchod pa rnams oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swā bha wa shuddhaḥsarba dharma swā bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badzra pa dyaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe swāhā/ zhes sogs nas/ oṃ badzra shapta swāhā/ oṃ badzra dharma ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bhuddha kṣe tra/ pra tsa li ni/ pradzñā pa ra mi ta/ na da swā bha we na badzra dharma hri da ya ṇi santo ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swāhā/ lan gsum rol mo dang bcas pa'o/ /bdag dang 'gro ba sogs nas/ dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes nyer gcig dang / sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du sangs rgyas sman bla'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ rang skad cig gis sangs rgyas sman blar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sangs rgyas sman gyi bla'i lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ thugs rjes kun la sogs phyag 'tshal lo/ /bhai kha dzye gu ru baiḍūrya pra bha ra dza ya sa pa ri bā ra oṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs nas/ shapta swāhā/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi nas/

sangs rgyas 'grub par shog lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sogs brjod/ oṃ swā bha wa sogs dang / stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor kyi steng du rang sems hūm̐ sngon po de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das sman lha sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pas dug gsum 'joms pa'i a ru ra dang / g.yon pas mnyam bzhag mdzad pa'i steng du sman gyi bdud rtsi'i gang ba'i lhung bzed bsnams pa/ na bza' chos gos rnam gsum ngur smrig gsol zhing / mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas su pad zla'i steng du maṃ las rgyal sras nyi ma ltar snang byed sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yon pa'i padma'i sdong po thugs kar bzung ba'i steng na nyi ma bsnams pa/ g.yon du pad zla'i steng na a las rgyal sras zla ba ltar snang byed sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yon pas pad ma'i sdong po thugs kar bzung ba'i steng na zla ba bsnams pa gnyis ka g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang / dar gyi stod g.yogs dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ gtso bo la 'dud pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sangs rgyas sman bla sogs la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par bstim/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ oṃ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/

zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la mi bskyod pa dang / 'khor la gtso bo nyid kyis dbur brgyan/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs te rang la thim/ oṃ bhai ṣa dzye bhai ṣa dzye ma hā bhai ṣa dzye rā dza sa mutga te swāhā/ zhes nye snying / oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ bhai ṣa dzye gu ru baiḍūrya pra bha rā dza ya/ ta tha ga ta ya arha te/ samyaksaṃ bhuddha ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ bhai ṣa dzye rā dza sa mutga te swāhā/ zhes dang / tadya thā/ ghu me ghu me/ i me ni mi hi ma ti ma ti sapta ta thā ga ta sa ma dhya dhiṣṭha ta/ a ta ma te/ pā le pā paṃ shoddha ni sarba pā paṃ na sha ya ma ma bhuddha buddhotta me/ u me ku me/ buddha kṣe tra pa ri shoddha ni/ dha me ni dha me me ru me ru shi kha re/ sarba a kā la mṛ tyu ni bā ra ṇi/ buddhe pu buddhe buddha a dhiṣṭhā na/ rakṣantu me sarba de ba sa me a sa me sa mantā ha rantu/ sarba buddha bo dhi satwa/ sha me sha me pra sha mantu me sarba i dhu pa dra ba byā ta ya/ pū ra ṇe pū ra ṇe pū ra ya me/ sarba ā sha ya/ baiḍūrya pra ti bhā se sarba pā paṃ kṣa yaṅka ri swāhā/ sngags gsum ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ snying ga nas ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ bhai ṣa dzye gu ru baiḍūrya pra bha ra dza ya sa pa ri bā ra arghaṃ sogs gong ltar dang / thugs rje kun la snyoms pa'i bcom 'das sogs kyis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ badzra muḥye shes pa gshegs/ 'khor gdan rang la thim/ gtor ma chus sbyongs nas dang po ni bsang sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum dang / rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas sman gyi bla baiḍūrya gtso 'khor gsum la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes padma ka ma la ya satwaṃ zhes sam bris 'bur yod na dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes bstim yang rung / gong ltar pad kor sngon 'gro'i thal mo khong stong dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis phul/ mchod bstod snga ma ltar dang / bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ gnyis pa oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum dang / a kā ro mu sogs lan gsum gyis gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon bcu gnyis la phul/ oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs kyis mchod/ rdzu 'phrul stobs dang mngon par shes pa'i dpal/ /nye bar thob nas thub pa'i bka' bzhin du/ /bstan pa rin chen bang mdzod legs skyong ba'i/ /rdo rje chos skyong rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsum pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin brlabs/ gzhi bdag la oṃ a kā ro sogs kyis phul/ gzhi bdag chen po 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di sogs nas/ kun 'grub shog yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa shlau ka gcig 'das gtor gyi mgron bris 'bur la bstim pa ltar na/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag 'bul na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swāhā/ zhes 'bru gtor/ bris 'bur med pa dang gtor mgron gzhan la khu tshur rgyab sbyar/ mtheb srin se gol bcas badzra muḥ zhes pas gshegs par bsam/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /sangs rgyas sman bla 'grub gyur nas/ /sogs/ sangs rgyas sman bla khyed sku sogs/ khyed la mchod cing sogs/ ston mchog dam pa sogs bya ste tshul nges dgong thun nas 'go bzung /

srod thun dpe sogs/ gso sbyang len shes na phyi phyag sngon 'gros blangs la thor thun/ de nas kha 'don gzhan/ snga thun gung tshigs dgong thun yi dam chos skyong sogs kyi gtor bsngo chags med yod na bya/ srod thun te nam grub bar la rigs 'gres zla gcig nye snying / yig 'bru nyer gsum pa bzhi 'bum/ snying po dang gzungs ring ci nus 'on kyang gzungs ring 'di stong phrag brgyad bzla bar gsungs pas 'grub na legs/ mtshams ma grol bar sgrub g.yog gcig gnyis dang / dmigs khongs su bcug pa'i sman pa/ phyogs nas yi ge dngos phran sogs len na ma gtogs/ gzhan 'grim 'grul tshang ma bcad/ rdor dkar dang khrus la 'bad nas/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi sgrib sbyong tshogs gsog tu dmigs pas rtse gcig bsgom bzlas byas la/ sbyin sreg byed par spro na thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i lha sngags mchod bstod/ gtor kha bsgyur ba ma gtogs rigs 'gre bas bsgyur dgos rnams gong gi bdag mdun bzhin no// //zhes pa sa skya pa kun blos sde dge rin chen chos rgyal gyi re skong du bris// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ sangs rgyas sman bla'i bsnyen yig nyung ngu don tshang / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
